simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דֵּעָה (H1844) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דֵּעָה (dêʻâh) means knowledge First listed occurrence: 1Sam 2 3.

definitions.full: H1844. deah דֵּעָה noun feminine knowledge (strictly Infinitive of ידע ) — דֵּעָה Psa 73:11 3 t.; plural דֵּעוֺת 1Sam 2:3 ; Job 36:4 ; — ד ׳תְּמִים 36:4 (of Elihu); of God's knowledge, ד ׳אֵל ׳י 1Sam 2:3 a God of knowledge is ׳י (on plural see Dr); בְעֶלְיוֺן דֵּעָה יֵשׁ Psa 73:11 (|| יָדַעאֵֿל אֵיכָה ); knowledge , with ׳י as object Isa 11:9 (where verbal force of noun appears); as taught by prophets 28:9 ; וְהַשְׂכֵּיל דֵּעָה אֶתְכֶם וְרָעוּ Jer 3:15 of ׳י s shepherds (i.e. future ideal rulers). Gr proposes (plausibly) רָעֹה , after ᵐ5 , see also Gie.
